rating_events.customer_facing_scope: only events with a real published destination rating are eligible for rating-movement claims; unresolved (null destination) and sentinel-destination events are excluded

predicate.real_destination: neither of the above and new_value is not null
predicate.sentinel_destination: trim(new_value::text,'"') in ['Inspected but not rated', 'No published rating', 'Insufficient evidence to rate']

representation_classes.no_destination_value: new_value is JSON null: the event records that a rating moved but not what it moved to
representation_classes.old_value_sentinel: old_value is a sentinel string, not a rating: ['Not Yet Inspected']
representation_classes.sentinel_destination: new_value is a sentinel string, not a rating: ['Inspected but not rated', 'No published rating', 'Insufficient evidence to rate']

unresolved_detail.definition: rating_changed events whose destination (new_value) is JSON null - all time
unresolved_detail.note: a sentinel prior value such as 'Not Yet Inspected' is a representation placeholder, not a rating, so these events cannot be presented as rating movements
